lenovo - ideapad 3i chromebook 15.6\" fh.description: Experience smooth multitasking and speedy on-the-go performance with the IdeaPad 3i Chromebook, your perfect companion for work or play wherever you are—featuring Google’s fast, secure operating system enhanced with AI tools that simplify even the toughest tasks, letting you write like a pro, design unique backgrounds, and reimagine photos through generative AI. Powered by an Intel Celeron N4500 Processor (2 cores, 2 threads, 1.1GHz base clock, up to 2.8GHz max turbo, 4MB Cache) paired with 4GB LPDDR4x RAM and 128GB total storage (64GB eMMc + 64GB SD Card), this Chromebook also includes a complimentary 3-month Google One AI Premium Plan with Gemini Advanced, 2TB of cloud storage, and Gemini integration in Gmail, Docs, and more when you purchase. Enjoy crisp visuals on the 15.6" FHD (1920x1080) TN 220nits anti-glare display, stay protected with the HD 720p webcam featuring a privacy shutter, and leverage Integrated Intel UHD Graphics that support expansion to up to 3 external digital monitors via HDMI and USB-C, each capable of FHD (1920x1080) @60Hz resolution. Stay connected effortlessly with versatile ports including USB-C 3.2 Gen 1, 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1, HDMI, a microSD card reader, a headphone/microphone combo jack, and a Kensington Nano Security Slot, plus Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax 2x2) and Bluetooth 5.2 for seamless wireless connectivity, all backed by a super long-lasting battery that delivers up to 10 hours of use. Running Chrome OS with an Auto Update Expiration (AUE) date of June 2030, this device grants access to popular apps for streaming, gaming, creating, and staying organized via Google Play, including easy access to Microsoft 365, Minecraft, Adobe Express, and more—secure, fast, always up-to-date, versatile, and simple, it’s ideal for online courses, online school, K12, K9, and college students, Zoom meetings, and video streaming alike.
